bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test -n "$CID" || exit 20
IMAGE=$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')
TAGLIST=$(docker image ls --no-trunc --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}|{{.ID}}' | awk -F'|' -v id="$IMAGE" '$2==id {print $1}' | head -15)
LABELS=$(docker image inspect "$IMAGE" --format '{{json .Config.Labels}}')
BUNDLE=$(docker exec "$CID" sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | awk '{print $1}')
BRANCHES=$(git -C /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot worktree list --porcelain | grep '^HEAD ' | tail -10 | cut -d' ' -f2 | cut -c1-12 | tr '\n' ',')
BODY=$(printf 'GAYBBS_SEARCH_LIVE_SOURCE_READBACK_20261114\nIMAGE_SHA=%s\nTAGS=%s\nBUNDLE_SHA256=%s\nWORKTREE_HEADS=%s\nLABELS=%s' "$IMAGE" "$TAGLIST" "$BUNDLE" "$BRANCHES" "$LABELS")
test -n "$TAGLIST"
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$BODY" >/dev/null
 echo LIVE_SOURCE_READBACK_RECORDED
else
 echo GH_NOT_AVAILABLE
 exit 91
fi
